title: HR Administrator
description:
We are very pleased to be working alongside our highly thought of and very friendly client as they seek to recruit a HR Administrator on a full time permanent basis

HR Administrator

East Grinstead area with plenty of parking available for all staff on site. Due to rural workplace with no nearby public transport links, you will need to be a driver and have your own vehicle

Full time permanent role - Monday - Friday (phone number removed) weeks of the year and Monday - Friday (phone number removed) weeks of the year

28500 per annum. 30 days holiday plus all UK bank holidays Good pension scheme and ongoing training and professional development.

This is a varied and very rewarding role working in a supportive and collaborative environment.

You'll be supporting the full employee lifecycle while also providing occasional support to the office and reception teams. You'll play a key role in recruitment, onboarding, compliance, HR administration and staff wellbeing initiatives, helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the HR function.

The role - HR Administrator

Reporting to the HR Manager, you will provide comprehensive administrative support across all aspects of HR and personnel administration.

Duties and responsibilities include:

Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases

Process new starter documentation and onboarding activities

Coordinate induction programmes and probation reviews

Monitor employee absence, holiday and training records

Produce reports and management information from HR systems

Coordinate staff training records and appraisal documentation

Support end-to-end recruitment administration

Arrange interviews and recruitment events

Prepare offer packs and employment documentation

Coordinate onboarding activities for new employees

Provide reception and administrative cover when required

Experience, skills and competencies required:

GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent)

Some experience within an HR administration role

Strong organisation and communication skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel

Ability to maintain strict confidentiality

CIPD Level 3 qualified (or higher)

Full UK driving licence and access to own transport - due to rural and unique workplace

For more information regarding this new and exciting HR Administration opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out!

Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job

title: Recruitment & Training Administrator
description:
Recruitment & Training Administrator

Location: Hove
Hours: Full-time 37.5 hours per week
Pay Rate: 13.88 per hour
Contract Type: 3 Years

We are currently recruiting for an experienced and highly organised Recruitment & Training Administrator to join a values-led organisation based in Hove. This is a varied position supporting both recruitment and training functions, offering the opportunity to work across multiple teams and projects within a busy professional environment.

The Role

This is a diverse administrative role where you will provide essential support across recruitment, training coordination, stakeholder engagement, and compliance administration. You'll be working closely with managers, colleagues, external partners, and candidates to ensure processes run smoothly and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinating training programmes, courses, and learning events.
- Managing databases, records, and compliance documentation.
- Providing administrative support across recruitment campaigns.
- Preparing recruitment packs, advertisements, offer documentation, and maintaining applicant records.
- Arranging interviews, meetings, and training sessions.
- Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate activities and communications.
- Monitoring key deadlines, training renewals, and compliance requirements.
- Maintaining accurate records in line with GDPR and organisational policies.
- Preparing agendas, taking meeting minutes, and supporting wider administrative activities.
- Handling telephone and email enquiries in a professional and timely manner.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous administration experience within a busy office environment.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Professional telephone manner and customer service approach.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Experience maintaining records and handling confidential information.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Interested?

If you're an experienced administrator looking for a varied position combining recruitment, training coordination, and stakeholder support, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your up-to-date CV and one of our consultants will be in touch to discuss current and upcoming opportunities that match your skills and experience.

title: Recruitment Admin (Part-Time) Temp
description:
Job Type: Recruitment Admin (Part-Time) Temp
Salary: 13.00 - 13.50ph
Location: Eastbourne
Key Responsibilities
- Providing general administrative support to the recruitment team.
- Updating and maintaining candidate and client records on the internal database.
- Formatting and editing CVs to a professional standard.
- Posting job advertisements across relevant recruitment platforms.
- Reviewing applications and assisting with candidate shortlisting.
- Contacting candidates to confirm availability, arrange interviews and obtain relevant information.
- Assisting with right-to-work checks and candidate registration paperwork.
- Preparing and sending emails to clients and candidates.
- Answering incoming calls and responding to general enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is completed correctly.
- Supporting consultants with ad hoc administrative duties as required.

Skills & Experience
- Previous administration experience is essential.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work independently
- A professional and friendly telephone manner.
- Previous recruitment or HR administration experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
